# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Read AGENTS.md first

**[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) holds all project rules** — what this repo is, repo layout,
toolchain, coding standards, testing, docs, git workflow, secrets, and anti-hallucination
constraints. Read it before doing anything in this repo. This file adds only GitHub Copilot specifics.

When a rule needs to change, edit `AGENTS.md`, not this file.
